author: Agustín Martínez Fayó
title: Enabling Authenticated Communication for Serverless Workloads with SPIRE
finding: Explains an external SVIDStore pattern when serverless platforms cannot colocate the ordinary SPIRE Agent, narrowing the book's deployment assumption.

author: Agustín Martínez Fayó
title: SPIRE Now Runs on Windows
finding: Documents Windows support that postdates and updates the first edition's platform coverage.

author: Evan Gilman
title: SPIFFE and SPIRE Projects Graduate from CNCF Incubator
finding: Reports later ecosystem adoption and maturity; useful as a change claim but still a project-governance source.

author: Heather Adkins
title: Q&A: Heather Adkins, Director of Information Security, Google
finding: Extends zero-trust discussion toward data-layer controls, peer review, MFA, justifications, and activity metadata; treats machine learning as analyst assistance rather than an autonomous replacement.

author: Heather Adkins and Phil Venables
title: How we're helping reshape the software supply chain ecosystem securely
finding: After SolarWinds, elevates artifact integrity and provenance from internal deployment practice to an ecosystem supply-chain priority.

author: Betsy Beyer
title: The Site Reliability Engineering book turns 6
finding: Describes core ideas as durable while emphasizing that the field evolves and pointing to continuing material, qualifying any frozen 2020 reading.
